141-1854-4050.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1854-4050.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-7705-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7705-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1818-2173-3899-5010.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.

Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.

Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.

Cast Kodama of the East Tree either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.

The token Kodama of the East Tree and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Repeat from step 7.

The token Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, targeting Hellkite Courser.

The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, putting Rootha from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Hellkite Courser token, adding {C}{C}.

Optionally, you may choose both modes of Saheeli's Artistry to create infinite tokens of any artifact(s) on the battlefield.

When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.

At least two additional creatures on the battlefield.

Acftivate Carnifex Demon by paying {B} and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on each other creature.
